subject: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@clearlake.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the draft order form based on our conversation (tiered pricing by throughput, 12-month term, and proposed minimum-commitment tiers). A few open commercial items I'd like to align on before legal redline:

- Pricing tiers: confirm expected monthly throughput band for each tier so we can lock the per-token rates.
- Minimum commit cadence: ClearLake asked for a quarterly commit with true-ups each month — we proposed a monthly invoice with quarterly true-up; want to confirm that structure works.
- Net terms: standard Redwood net30; ClearLake accounting asked about net45 for the first year while they onboard. Any flexibility?
- Tax treatment: multi-entity invoicing possibility — do you want invoices to go to the US entity or to the EU subsidiary for VAT registration?

If you can confirm the throughput bands and whether net45 is required for year 1, we'll push the order form to legal for a short redline round. I copied Lauren (ops lead) and Karthik (finance) to weigh in on invoicing mechanics.

Next step: if you can reply with the two bullets (throughput bands + net terms), I'll circulate the redline.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: ClearLake_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx (order form draft)
From: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@clearlake.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@clearlake.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake

Hi Marcus —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers below:

- Throughput bands: we expect a pilot month at ~200M tokens, then ramp to 600-900M tokens/month by month 3. For contracting, please tier the pricing bands: 0-250M, 250-750M, 750M+.
- Net terms: our procurement team prefers net45 for year 1 while we complete PO setup. After year 1, net30 is our standard.
- Invoicing entity: invoices should be issued to ClearLake Systems, Inc. (US entity). VAT question is N/A for this purchase (US invoicing).

I'll route the draft to our legal counsel after your redline.

Regards,
Sarah Mendez
Head of Cloud Partnerships | ClearLake Systems
sarah.mendez@clearlake.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@clearlake.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake

Thanks Sarah — good clarifications. A few internal notes and asks before we share to legal:

- We'll model pricing tiers as Sarah requested (0-250M / 250-750M / 750M+). Marcus, please confirm the per-tier rates in the redline — I'll include a simple annualized cost table for their review.
- Net45 for year 1: finance can accept net45 for one renewal cycle if we get a signed PO and a 50% upfront payment on month 1 of the initial quarter. Karthik — can you confirm if the upfront deposit is acceptable?
- Invoicing entity: confirm US legal entity. If the customer later requests EU invoices, we'll need an addendum.

I'll prepare a short memo for legal highlighting three change items: net terms exception (net45 + 50% deposit), tiered pricing schedule, and monthly invoice + quarterly true-up language. Once Marcus confirms rates, I will attach the memo and send to Legal for redline.

- Lauren
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: Invoice_Cadence_Attachment.pdf (billing flow diagram)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@clearlake.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake

Lauren/Karthik — quick confirmation:

- Per-tier rates (proposed): 0-250M = $0.00085/token; 250-750M = $0.00065/token; 750M+ = $0.00050/token. These are exclusive of taxes.
- Upfront deposit: 50% of the initial quarter invoice works for Sales if Finance approves.

Priyom — looping you for one-line legal asks: please prioritize a straightforward order form redline with the three items Lauren outlined. We should avoid changing the MSA substantially; focus on the order form commercial table, invoice cadence, and net-term exception.

I'll attach the updated order form (v2) when legal has redlines.

Marcus
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@clearlake.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@clearlake.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Commercial cadence: tiered pricing & commitment cadence for ClearLake (Order Form redline)

Team & Sarah —

Attached is Redwood legal's redline to the order form (ClearLake_OrderForm_Redline_v2.docx). Summary of changes for commercial team and the customer:

1) Pricing table: added explicit per-tier rates and clarified that rates are per-consumed token and billed monthly.
2) Minimum commitment cadence: order form now specifies monthly invoicing with a quarterly reconciliation (true-up) and explicit examples for rounding and proration on ramp months.
3) Net terms exception: agreed to net45 for the first 12 months provided ClearLake submits a PO and pays a 50% deposit for the first quarter within 15 days of the executed order form. After 12 months, default net30 applies.
4) Tax and invoicing entity: invoices will be issued to ClearLake Systems, Inc. Redwood reserves the right to reissue invoices if tax registration changes; any VAT liability remains the customer's responsibility.

Open items for Sales to confirm before sending the redline to ClearLake legal:
- Confirm you are comfortable with the explicit deposit language and the 15-day window (Marcus).
- Approve the example rounding rules in section 3.2 (Lauren).

Once Sales confirms, I'll share the doc to Sarah/Paul with a brief cover note and DocuSign tag for signatures.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: ClearLake_OrderForm_Redline_v2.docx; Invoice_Cadence_Attachment.pdf
